== Build notes (Alpha6, 22 November 2026) ==
Article created for swccg-guild/work#1312 from Bill Bisco's 14 images (22 November 2026). All of them were already on the wiki as identical files (uploaded earlier the same day from the SWCCG Discord, or from the forum for [[:File:2022 PC20 Tournament sleeves.jpg]]), so nothing new was uploaded; the File pages now note the printed credits and that Bill supplied them.

=== Missing data ===
* Release dates of the 2023 (R2-D2) and 2024 (BB-8) logos: the only dated sources found are SWCCG Discord posts (13 February 2023 and 13 January 2024, per the File pages), which cannot be preserved, so the article gives no dates.
* PC stress ball: the File page links it to the 2023 Road to Worlds sign-ups (Discord, 4 July 2023); no forum or @swccg source found, so the article only shows it in the gallery.
* Kylo Ren deckbox credit: only "... Shiva Cosplay" is legible in the photo.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* [[SWCCGinPublic]] said 21–30 April 2022. The forum announcement (6 April 2023) and @swccg (7 April 2023, "Saturday April 22nd") put it in 2023; corrected there.

=== Resolved ===
* The 2022 Next Generation deckboxes were PC XL Series 1: Bill Bisco confirmed this on 23 November 2026 (the 2023 Donations article and the Thrawn teaser had only implied it). The article now names them Series 1, cited as personal communication. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 09:24, 23 November 2026 (UTC)
* [[:File:2022 PC20 Tournament sleeves.jpg]] stays at its current 2400 px size; Bill Bisco decided on 23 November 2026 not to replace it with his 4032 px original. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 09:24, 23 November 2026 (UTC)

=== Preservation ===
* @swccg posts are preserved as swccg.com snapshots (x.com cannot be saved by the Wayback Machine directly), then captured to the Internet Archive.
